_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Murder Mystery#000.dst: 与 [-{~}, -{~}] 的 Lorias 探长对话。

Murder Mystery#001.src: Stand back, human! This is a crime scene, under my authority. I cannot let you inside.
Murder Mystery#001.dst: 退后，人类！这里是犯罪现场，由我负责。我不能让你进去。
Murder Mystery#001.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#002.src: Although we are in need of some... assistance... and you are fairly experienced, are you not?
Murder Mystery#002.dst: 不过我们确实需要一些……协助……而你经验相当丰富，不是吗？
Murder Mystery#002.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#003.src: Well, straight to the point... do you think I might be able to hire you as a private investigator?
Murder Mystery#003.dst: 好吧，我直说了……你觉得我能不能雇你当私家侦探？
Murder Mystery#003.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#004.src: To put it bluntly, the owner of this house, Eminar, was murdered a few days ago, and what few leads we had have all gone cold.
Murder Mystery#004.dst: 说白了，这栋房子的主人 Eminar 几天前被谋杀了，而我们仅有的几条线索全都断了。
Murder Mystery#004.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#005.src: This is acting outside protocol, of course... but if you manage to catch the killer, I'm sure I could pull some strings and pay you for your work!
Murder Mystery#005.dst: 当然，这不符合规定……不过如果你能抓到凶手，我敢肯定能动用点关系付你报酬！
Murder Mystery#005.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#006.src: I'll make sure no one stops you inside the crime scene. Head inside the house and see if you can find anything helpful.
Murder Mystery#006.dst: 我会确保没人在犯罪现场拦你。进屋去，看看能不能找到有用的东西。
Murder Mystery#006.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#007.src: My soldiers and I will keep watch outside the house, and make sure you're not disturbed. Be careful in there!
Murder Mystery#007.dst: 我和我的士兵会在屋外看守，确保没人打扰你。在里面小心点！
Murder Mystery#007.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#008.src: Investigate the crime scene at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for clues.

Murder Mystery#009.src: Ah, a human! A refreshing sight these days. You've come to see me, I presume? What brings you here?
Murder Mystery#009.dst: 啊，一个人类！这年头真是难得一见。我猜你是来找我的？有什么事？
Murder Mystery#009.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#010.src: An investigation!? Eminar? That's... that's absurd. I've done nothing wrong.
Murder Mystery#010.dst: 调查！？Eminar？这……这太荒唐了。我什么都没做错。
Murder Mystery#010.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#011.src: Still, the poor man. Eminar and I were good friends, you know. If it could help find his killer, I may have some information for you... strictly off-record, of course...
Murder Mystery#011.dst: 不过，那个可怜人。你知道，Eminar 跟我是好朋友。如果能帮忙找到杀他的凶手，我也许有些情报给你……当然，完全私下说……
Murder Mystery#011.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#012.src: Well. You see, there's an underground gambling den hidden in the city's sewers. Only the elite can get in, and Eminar happened to be a frequent visitor.
Murder Mystery#012.dst: 好吧。是这样的，城里的下水道里藏着一个地下赌场。只有上流人士才能进去，而 Eminar 正好是那里的常客。
Murder Mystery#012.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#013.src: Once, he even brought me along with him.
Murder Mystery#013.dst: 有一次，他甚至带我一起去了。
Murder Mystery#013.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#014.src: Eminar, though, he often tried to cheat the other gamblers. I suppose it was only a matter of time before they had enough; most do not take cheating lightly.
Murder Mystery#014.dst: 不过 Eminar 常常想出老千骗其他赌徒。我想他们迟早会受不了；大多数人可不会轻易放过出老千的人。
Murder Mystery#014.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#015.src: Back to the point, many of them, including poor Eminar, had a symbol built into the sides of their homes, shaped like a snake. A proof of membership, you could say.
Murder Mystery#015.dst: 说回正题，他们很多人，包括可怜的 Eminar，房子侧面都嵌着一个蛇形的标志。可以说是会员的证明。
Murder Mystery#015.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#016.src: If you can find it, it will show you the way to get into the sewers. I'm sorry, I would tell you more if I knew more. But good luck with your investigation, sir.
Murder Mystery#016.dst: 如果你能找到它，它就会告诉你怎么进下水道。抱歉，如果我知道更多一定会告诉你。祝你调查顺利，先生。
Murder Mystery#016.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#017.src: Return to the victim's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find a snake symbol.
Murder Mystery#017.dst: 回到 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 的受害者家里，寻找蛇形标志。

Murder Mystery#018.src: Find the gamblers in the {p} sewers.
Murder Mystery#018.dst: 在 {p} 的下水道里找到那些赌徒。

Murder Mystery#019.src: How did ya find us down 'ere? I don't remember you... you're with the police, aren't ya? Here after Eminar, I suppose?
Murder Mystery#019.dst: 你是怎么找到这下面来的？我不记得你……你是警察的人吧？我猜是为 Eminar 来的？
Murder Mystery#019.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#020.src: Yeah, we've 'eard about what happened to him. Murders don't happen every day up there, ya know. And as it happened, I saw Eminar down here, not too long ago...
Murder Mystery#020.dst: 对，我们听说他出事了。上面可不是天天都有谋杀案，你知道的。说来也巧，不久前我还在这下面见过 Eminar……
Murder Mystery#020.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#021.src: Well... as long as I get a guarantee I won't be shut down, I'll help ya. This is a very profitable place, as I'm sure ya might've guessed.
Murder Mystery#021.dst: 好吧……只要能保证我这里不会被查封，我就帮你。你大概也猜到了，这地方非常赚钱。
Murder Mystery#021.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#022.src: He was brought down here by his friend one day. Rohem, it was. A fine customer, you understand. Never failed to pay his dues...
Murder Mystery#022.dst: 有一天他被他朋友带下来。是 Rohem。一位好客人，你懂的。从来没欠过账……
Murder Mystery#022.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#023.src: But the day he brought Eminar 'round, though, it got ugly fast. Kept borrowing Rohem's emeralds and losing, till neither of em had anythin' left.
Murder Mystery#023.dst: 可他带 Eminar 来的那天，局面很快就变得难看了。一直借 Rohem 的绿宝石，一直输，最后两个人都输光了。
Murder Mystery#023.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#024.src: It was a good day for me, for obvious reasons, don'cha see! But Rohem was furious. Dead drunk, too, but what else is new!
Murder Mystery#024.dst: 那天对我来说可是好日子，原因很明显，你懂吧！可 Rohem 气坏了。也喝得烂醉，不过这也不是什么新鲜事！
Murder Mystery#024.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#025.src: Neither of 'em has been back since, though in Eminar's case, I can see why! And I hope that's enough for ya, 'cause that's all I got.
Murder Mystery#025.dst: 从那以后他们俩都没再来过，不过 Eminar 的话，我懂为什么！希望这些对你够用了，因为我知道的就这么多。
Murder Mystery#025.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#026.src: Now get out of 'ere; there's a back exit in the wall over there. Though, if ya ever fancy a game of 'jack, come back'n we'll be happy to serve ya!
Murder Mystery#026.dst: 好了，出去吧；那边墙上有个后门出口。不过，如果你哪天想玩把 21 点，回来吧，我们乐意奉陪！
Murder Mystery#026.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#027.src: Confront Rohem about the murder at house #{~} in {p}.
Murder Mystery#027.dst: 到 {p} 的 #{~} 号房子质问 Rohem 谋杀案的事。

Murder Mystery#028.src: Ah... you again! You're back. I see that. I must admit, I did not expect you to return... so soon...
Murder Mystery#028.dst: 啊……又是你！你回来了。我看到了。我得承认，我没想到你会……这么快回来……
Murder Mystery#028.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#029.src: You really did find your way down there? Oh, that's... excellent... I hope the investigation is going well. Now if you'll just leave me be-
Murder Mystery#029.dst: 你真的找到路下去了？噢，那……太好了……希望调查进展顺利。好了，如果你能让我清静一下——
Murder Mystery#029.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#030.src: Valimare? Bah! Why would you trust anything he says? He's a criminal! A scam artist! I mean, I did direct you to him, but...
Murder Mystery#030.dst: Valimare？呸！你为什么要相信他说的话？他是个罪犯！一个骗子！我是说，是我指引你去找他的，但是……
Murder Mystery#030.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#031.src: He- He's the one you should be arresting. Eminar was a danger to society, got what he deserved, the fool-
Murder Mystery#031.dst: 他——他才是你该逮捕的人。Eminar 是社会的祸害，他罪有应得，那个蠢货——
Murder Mystery#031.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#032.src: Wait! No! Don't turn me in! Can't you let me finish my drink in peace? Get out, get out, you can't prove anything!
Murder Mystery#032.dst: 等等！不！别告发我！就不能让我安安静静喝完这杯吗？出去，出去，你什么都证明不了！
Murder Mystery#032.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#033.src: Besides, have you ever heard of a little thing called evidence? You don't have any proof!
Murder Mystery#033.dst: 再说，你听说过一种叫证据的东西吗？你根本没有证据！
Murder Mystery#033.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#034.src: Now, officer, if you don't have a proper warrant, I expect you to vacate my property immediately!
Murder Mystery#034.dst: 好了，警官，如果你没有正式的搜查令，我希望你立刻离开我的地方！
Murder Mystery#034.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#035.src: Find the murder weapon around Rohem's house at house #{~} in {p}.
Murder Mystery#035.dst: 在 {p} #{~} 号房子 Rohem 家周围找到凶器。

Murder Mystery#036.src: Hi! I'm digging a hole in my garden, just like Mr. Rohem did last night!
Murder Mystery#036.dst: 嗨！我在我家花园里挖洞，就跟 Rohem 先生昨晚一样！
Murder Mystery#036.speaker: Child

Murder Mystery#037.src: For the last time officer, would you either show me a warrant or get out of my- what are you doing in my garden?!
Murder Mystery#037.dst: 我最后说一次，警官，要么给我看搜查令，要么滚出我的——你在我花园里干什么？！
Murder Mystery#037.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#038.src: A... a hatchet? I don't know what you mean, I- I've never seen that before in my life!
Murder Mystery#038.dst: 一……一把手斧？我不知道你在说什么，我——我这辈子从没见过那东西！
Murder Mystery#038.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#039.src: Gah! Curse you, human! I might be headed to jail, but I can send you straight to hell!
Murder Mystery#039.dst: 啊！该死的人类！我也许要进监狱了，但我可以先送你下地狱！
Murder Mystery#039.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#040.src: That's enough, Rohem! Stand down, or the guards will attack.
Murder Mystery#040.dst: 够了，Rohem！放下武器，否则守卫就要动手了。
Murder Mystery#040.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#041.src: Augh! Fine, you've got me. But mark my words, this won't be the last you hear of me, human!
Murder Mystery#041.dst: 啊！好吧，算你抓到我了。但你记住，人类，这不会是你最后一次听到我的名字！
Murder Mystery#041.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#042.src: Whatever you pale-faced walking cowlick. You're headed to {p} Penitentiary with a charge of first-class murder. Guards, take him away.
Murder Mystery#042.dst: 随便你怎么说，你这个脸色惨白、走路的呆毛。你要以一级谋杀罪被送进 {p} 监狱了。守卫，把他带走。
Murder Mystery#042.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#043.src: As for you, human, please accept my immense gratitude. We probably wouldn't have caught that rat without you.
Murder Mystery#043.dst: 至于你，人类，请接受我无比的感激。没有你，我们大概抓不到那只老鼠。
Murder Mystery#043.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#044.src: On behalf of the city of {p}, please accept these emeralds as compensation for your services. You were a fine detective today!
Murder Mystery#044.dst: 我代表 {p} 城，请收下这些绿宝石作为你服务的报酬。你今天是个出色的侦探！
Murder Mystery#044.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#045.src: Heya there! Fancy a quick game of blackjack?
Murder Mystery#045.dst: 嘿！想来一局快速的 21 点吗？
Murder Mystery#045.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#046.dst: 好嘞，我们来玩 21 点吧！
Murder Mystery#046.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#047.src: Good stuff! Put ya money in the pot and I'll start the deal.
Murder Mystery#047.dst: 好样的！把钱放进奖池，我就开始发牌。
Murder Mystery#047.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#048.src: Not feelin' up to playin' right now? No worries, just drop by later!
Murder Mystery#048.dst: 现在不想玩？没关系，晚点再来吧！
Murder Mystery#048.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#049.src: Not right now? No worries - come back another time!
Murder Mystery#049.dst: 现在不行？没关系——下次再来吧！
Murder Mystery#049.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#050.src: Ah, new to the game huh? No worries, lemme tell ya all about it!
Murder Mystery#050.dst: 啊，第一次玩是吧？没关系，我来跟你讲讲！
Murder Mystery#050.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#051.src: The rules are simple! I deal two cards face up to ya both face down, and two cards to me, one face up and one face down.
Murder Mystery#051.dst: 规则很简单！我给你发两张牌，给我自己也发两张，一张明牌一张暗牌。
Murder Mystery#051.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#052.src: Ya can hit and get another card as many times as ya want, or stand and end ya turn. The aim is to get the value of your hand as close to {~} as possible!
Murder Mystery#052.dst: 你可以要牌，想要几次都行，也可以停牌结束你的回合。目标是让你手上的点数尽量接近 {~}！
Murder Mystery#052.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#053.src: Number cards are worth what they say, all picture cards are worth {~}, and an ace can be worth either {~} or {~}, whichever works best for ya hand.
Murder Mystery#053.dst: 数字牌就是牌面上的点数，所有人头牌都算 {~}，A 可以算 {~} 或 {~}，看哪个对你的牌最有利。
Murder Mystery#053.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#054.src: Go over {~} and that's it - you're bust! Stand with your current hand and it's my turn to hit or stand to try and beat your hand.
Murder Mystery#054.dst: 超过 {~} 就完了——你爆牌了！你停牌之后就轮到我要牌或停牌，想办法赢过你的牌。
Murder Mystery#054.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#055.src: And if ya get a blackjack - that's an ace and a picture card or a ten - ya automatically get double ya money back!
Murder Mystery#055.dst: 如果你拿到 21 点——也就是一张 A 加一张人头牌或 10——就自动拿回双倍的钱！
Murder Mystery#055.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#056.src: Sound fair enough? Alrighty, just right-click me again to play!
Murder Mystery#056.dst: 听起来很公平吧？好嘞，再右键点击我一次就开始玩！
Murder Mystery#056.speaker: Blackjack Dealer
